title: Composed supervisory control: Mode-selected start latch with restart inhibit -> Safe restart after power or safety interruption

outputs.name: A_RestartRequired
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Manual restart acknowledgement required

outputs.name: B_RestartInhibit
outputs.description: Subsystem B: A fresh reset is required

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan B_Start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_AutoMode shall select A_AutoStart; manual mode shall select A_ManualStart.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Stop, A_Enable FALSE, or A_SafetyOK FALSE shall force A_Running FALSE with priority over every start.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Safety loss while A_Running or while a start is requested shall latch A_RestartRequired.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_RestartRequired may clear only when A_Reset is TRUE, A_SafetyOK and A_Enable are TRUE, and the selected start is released.
requirements.property: G((A_RestartRequired AND !(A_Reset AND A_SafetyOK AND A_Enable AND !selected_start)) -> X(A_RestartRequired))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A start presented while A_RestartRequired is TRUE shall not run and shall pulse A_RejectedStart.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: With all permissions healthy and no restart inhibit, a selected start shall latch A_Running until a A_Stop condition occurs.
requirements.property: G((selected_start AND A_Enable AND A_SafetyOK AND !A_Stop AND !A_RestartRequired) -> A_Running)

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Loss of B_PowerOK or B_SafetyOK shall B_Stop B_Running and set B_RestartInhibit.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((!B_PowerOK OR !B_SafetyOK) -> ((!B_Running) AND B_RestartInhibit)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop shall B_Stop B_Running without by itself setting B_RestartInhibit.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset may clear B_RestartInhibit only when B_PowerOK and B_SafetyOK are TRUE and B_Start is FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((prev(B_RestartInhibit) AND !B_RestartInhibit) -> (B_Reset AND B_PowerOK AND B_SafetyOK AND !B_Start)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Running shall remain FALSE while B_RestartInhibit is TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: After B_Reset, a new B_Start may run the machine when B_PowerOK, B_SafetyOK, and not B_Stop hold.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Start AND !B_RestartInhibit AND B_PowerOK AND B_SafetyOK AND !B_Stop) -> B_Running))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Running shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Running AND NOT B_RestartInhibit)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Running AND NOT B_RestartInhibit))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
